relationships.subject: morphine
relationships.evidence_quote: a morphine-TLR4 signaling pathway increases phagocytic activity in microglia independent of sex

relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: the effect of 10<sup>-12</sup> M morphine in striatal microglia plated at 10 K density is mediated via TLR4, and not μORs

key_findings: 10^-12 M morphine increased phagocytosis in striatal microglia in vitro, independent of sex.
The morphine effect in striatal microglia at 10K density was mediated via TLR4 and not mu opioid receptors.
